title: Token-window telemetry and adaptive redaction for streaming API
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Problem: Our current streaming observability captures only end-of-response aggregates (total latency, token count) and occasional full-trace spans. This leaves blind spots for long-running responses where per-emission anomalies (stalls, redaction failures, sudden payload amplification) cause customer incidents without clear root cause.

Proposal: Implement a token-window telemetry model and an adaptive redaction shim for streamed content. Token-window telemetry emits lightweight per-window metrics (every N tokens or M ms) that include latency buckets, bytes emitted, tokens emitted, and an opaque span reference. The adaptive redaction shim performs configurable, incremental redaction on emitted frames and reports redaction events as telemetry rather than logging raw content.

Goals: 1) Enable fast detection of micro-regressions (per-window p95 latency spikes, emission size growth). 2) Maintain privacy by never transmitting unredacted streamed payload to long-term logs; surface redaction events and provenance metadata instead. 3) Provide backward-compatible headers and a compatibility shim so older SDKs continue to function without modification.
acceptance_criteria: Per-window telemetry is emitted for all streaming responses behind a feature flag (default off) and can be toggled per-tenant
Telemetry includes: window_start_ms, window_end_ms, emitted_tokens, emitted_bytes, p50/p95/p99 latency for that window, span_ref_id, redaction_events_count
Redaction shim removes or masks PII patterns in stream frames before any logs or traces leave host process; redaction events are summarized in telemetry (count/type) and never contain raw PII
Runtime exposes a compatibility header X-RW-Stream-Compat that allows older SDKs to opt out or accept aggregated windows instead of per-window events
Integration tests cover sampling, backpressure, and redaction correctness for at least 3 model families (transformer-base, long-context, encoder-decoder)
End-to-end perf regression < 3% p50 latency for normal small responses when feature enabled (measured on dedicated staging GPUs)
notes: Implementation will add a bounded ringbuffer per-stream to aggregate windows before emission to avoid synchronization hotspots
Use UUIDv4 for span_ref_id; include short hash of request id for traceability without exposing tokens
Sampling: global probabilistic sampling for high-volume customers plus deterministic sampling for requests flagged by QA or canaries
decisions: Decided to use metric emission over gRPC stream metadata to separate telemetry and user payloads
Redaction rules limited to regex + token-blacklist for v1; ML-powered redaction will be scoped to v2
Compatibility header X-RW-Stream-Compat will carry values: legacy|windows-v1|windows-v2
test_plan: Unit tests for redaction rules and false positive rate < 0.5% on synthetic PII corpus
Integration test to assert no unredacted content appears in logs for 10k synthetic streaming sessions
Load test to validate telemetry emission overhead at 5k concurrent streams with 1M tokens/sec total
rollback_plan: Feature gated rollout: can disable token-window telemetry and redaction shim via tenant flag; if unexpected errors occur we revert feature flag and apply a hotfix removing window emissions; full rollback timeline documented in SRE runbook
implementation_steps: Schema: define protobuf for WindowTelemetry (window_start_ms, window_end_ms, emitted_tokens, emitted_bytes, latencies, span_ref_id, redaction_summary)
Engine: integrate per-stream ringbuffer into runtime event loop; ensure non-blocking flush
Redaction: ship shim with configurable regex/token lists and audit-only mode first
SDK: update JS/Go/Java SDKs to honor X-RW-Stream-Compat and surface windows via callbacks
QA: run integration + privacy tests on staging and dedicated clusters
risks: Telemetry volume explosion for high-token sessions; mitigated via configurable window size and reservoir sampling
False positives from regex redaction may reduce utility; we will add an audit-only mode to tune rules before full masking
Compatibility breakage if older SDKs mis-handle new headers; include clear migration guidance and opt-out via header
customer_communication: Draft status page blurb for limited beta and expected telemetry semantics
Notify pilot customers with opt-in instructions and data retention policy for redaction summaries
